desc: switch to using BLS config files
r: grub-switch-to-blscfg - switch to using BLS config files

Switch to BLS config files.\n

-h, --help
print this message and exit
-V, --version
print the version information and exit
--backup-suffix=SUFFIX
.bak
--bls-directory=DIR
/boot/loader/entries
--config-file=FILE
/etc/grub2-efi.cfg
--grub-defaults=FILE
/etc/default/grub
--grub-directory=DIR
/boot/efi/EFI/rocky/

The full documentation for grub-switch-to-blscfg is maintained as a Texinfo manual. If the info and grub-switch-to-blscfg programs are properly installed at your site, the command

info grub-switch-to-blscfg

should give you access to the complete manual.
